BackstoryDef.title: femur broken child
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] underwent experiments on the durability of [PAWN_possessive] bones. As a result, [PAWN_possessive] bones are stronger than usual, at the expense of [PAWN_nameDef]'s mental state.

BackstoryDef.title: disturbed sleeper
BackstoryDef.description: As part of an experiment on sawian stamina, [PAWN_nameDef] was subjected to constant physical tests with very little sleep in-between. \nThe experience has trained [PAWN_nameDef] how to sleep lightly, at the cost of [PAWN_possessive] cellmates.

BackstoryDef.title: forced augmentation
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was subjected at an early age to various experiments which involved invasive body-modification while [PAWN_pronoun] was still awake.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] is unable to look at body augments again without being reminded of the agonizing pain.

BackstoryDef.title: mess hall bully
BackstoryDef.description: In [PAWN_nameDef]'s section, food rations were intentionally underrationed. To survive, [PAWN_nameDef] learnt how to fight with [PAWN_pronoun] fists.

BackstoryDef.title: selfless child
BackstoryDef.description: The odd one out in [PAWN_possessive] section; [PAWN_nameDef] was known for [PAWN_possessive] exceptional kindness and optimistic worldview.

BackstoryDef.title: circadian anomaly
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was used as a subject to study circadian rhythms and how light influenced sleep schedules. After months of work, the scientists were able to invert [PAWN_nameDef] rhythm. \nBeing awake when everyone else was asleep has socially isolated [PAWN_nameDef] however.

BackstoryDef.title: braingrow defect
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] brain was used to fine tune an improved version of the Braingrow Medicine. \nUnfortunately, due to a miscalibration of the mechanites, [PAWN_nameDef]'s hippocampus was damaged, impairing [PAWN_possessive] ability to learn.

BackstoryDef.title: sickly child
BackstoryDef.description: When compared to the other sawians, [PAWN_nameDef] seemed way more prone to getting sick than [PAWN_possessive] peers. \nSensing an oppertunity, the scientists used [PAWN_objective] as a test subject for testing experimental medicines.

BackstoryDef.title: burnt savant
BackstoryDef.description: After discovering [PAWN_nameDef] talent in art, the scientists subjected [PAWN_objective] to an endless barrage of tests to gauge the extent of [PAWN_possessive] abilities. \nWhile this experience would of burnt many people away from artistic pursuits forever, [PAWN_nameDef] is unable to fight the urge to create.

BackstoryDef.title: scientist's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Picked out by a new scientist specifically, [PAWN_nameDef] was treated more akin to a pet vs. being the subject of various science experiments. This granted [PAWN_objective] the oppertunity to learn from the scientists \nHowever, this special treatment has encouraged [PAWN_nameDef] to believe that [PAWN_pronoun] is above others.

BackstoryDef.title: trained hunter
BackstoryDef.description: With the direction of a notorious scientist, [PAWN_nameDef] was raised to be a ruthless hunter. \nWith [PAWN_possessive] brain rewired, [PAWN_nameDef] became unable to socialize with [PAWN_possessive] peers, stitch up wounds, or aim carefully.

BackstoryDef.title: secret reader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was able to smuggle a book on farming from a hallway trashcan. With the assistance of an older sawian, [PAWN_pronoun] was taught how to read. \nAfter finishing the book on [PAWN_possessive] own, [PAWN_nameDef] wanted to thank the sawian, but was unable to find them again.

BackstoryDef.title: dune caretaker
BackstoryDef.description: For some reason, [PAWN_nameDef]'s sector was assigned a Dune sawian. Completely ignored by any of the scientists and the other sawians, [PAWN_nameDef] took it upon themselves to help care for the dune.

BackstoryDef.title: sector cook
BackstoryDef.description: One day while eating [PAWN_possessive] rations, [PAWN_nameDef] realize that some part of the constantly rotating rations paired well with some from the other days. \nAfter some convincing, [PAWN_pronoun] was able to have some of [PAWN_possessive] sector mates to hold onto some of their rations so [PAWN_pronoun] could combine them for a more appetizing meal.

BackstoryDef.title: bleak child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s time with The Company™ was a complete nightmare. Between the constant experiments, crackdowns, and the Cargo Mission; [PAWN_nameDef] has become convinenced that [PAWN_possessive] life will not get better.

BackstoryDef.title: defiant child
BackstoryDef.description: Despite [PAWN_nameDef]'s harsh treatment by the scientists and the company as a whole, [PAWN_possessive] will never broke. [PAWN_nameDef] remained defiant and caused issues with the scientists until [PAWN_pronoun] was deployed.

BackstoryDef.title: improviser
BackstoryDef.description: From a young age, [PAWN_nameDef] knew that to survive under the gaze of The Company™ that [PAWN_pronoun] would need to be crafty. \nWhile putting up less of a resistence than others, [PAWN_nameDef] put in the work to silently learn how improvise devices while others weren't looking
